This is an application for pre-arrest bail.

The applicants are apprehending arrest in connection with C.R.
No.396 of 2022 dated 07/06/2022 registered with Akluj Police Station for offence punishable under sections 420,
406, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 3.
By an order dated 25/07/2022, while granting interim protection, this Court has passed the following order.

"1. The applicants are apprehending their arrests in  connection with a crime registered with Akluj Police  Station, Dist. Solapur under Section 420, 406, 506 r/w 34  of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4 of the Dowry  Prohibition Act, 1961 on alleged misrepresentation by the  bridegroom and the applicants.

2. At the time of fixation of marriage, it was told by the  parents of the applicant, who is bridegroom, that the  applicant is working as a Headmaster and having around  200 Acres of land as well as 4 to 5 JCB machines.
It is also  alleged that he represented himself as a Government  Contractor.
3. Ultimately, it was found that the applicant no.1 has not  only concealed his real age which is 38 years, but it was  shown that he was 30 years old at the time of Mangal  Parinaya Ceremony.

The parents of the bride spent around  Rs.2,97,240/- and have purchased cloths, A.C. firdge, T.V.
 etc.
4. One of the co-accused has already granted protection by  this Court.

5. Learned APP submits that the applicants might misuse Somnath Sanjay Bhosale And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/165085293/

 which would affect the future prospects of the bride and,
 therefore, conditions needs to be imposed to co-operate  with the Investigating Agency.
 6.
